title: Positive-rank local extension of finite free stalk maps
statement: Let Y be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], r and s positive natural numbers, y a point of Y, and F_r and F_s the canonical finite free structure sheaves [def-weil-pbc-free-module] on ULift (Fin r) and ULift (Fin s). Given t: T(F_r) → T(F_s), where T is ordinary module pullback [def-pc-module-pullback] along Y.fromSpecStalk y, there is an open neighbourhood U of y and g: R_U(F_r) → R_U(F_s), where R_U is restriction, such that S_U(g) = E_U(F_r).hom ; t ; E_U(F_s).inv. Here S_U is pullback along U.fromSpecStalkOfMem y and E_U: R_U ⋙ S_U ≅ T is exactly the underlying module natural isomorphism used in [def-pc-stalk-restriction-complex-iso]: restriction-as-pullback followed by pullback composition and pullbackCongr for U.fromSpecStalkOfMem y ≫ U.ι = Y.fromSpecStalk y.

source.place: Finite matrix coefficient extension after excluding rank-zero cases

proof.text: Set V to the top open of Y. Identify the restrictions of the two standard free sheaves to V with the standard free sheaves on V using restrictFreeIso. Transport t along the canonical comparison E_V and these free isomorphisms to a map f over the ambient stalk spectrum. These constructions use the ordinary Modules.pullback and its composition and congruence isomorphisms, not tensorPullback.

Apply exists_finite_free_matrices_of_stalk_local with the singleton index type Unit and constant ranks r and s to f. It gives an open U contained in V, membership of y in U, and a single restricted free map whose stalk pullback is conjugation of f by stalkRestrictionWithinIso.

Transport this local map by the restrictions of restrictFreeIso and the natural isomorphism C from restriction along U.ι to restriction first to V and then to U. Form E_prime by whiskering C with stalk pullback, applying the functor associator, whiskering the within-open comparison by restriction to V, and composing with E_V. Naturality of the within-open comparison and cancellation of the free isomorphisms prove S_U(g_prime) = E_prime.hom ; t ; E_prime.inv.

Compare E_prime with the exact requested comparison E_U via the natural automorphism D = E_prime.symm followed by E_U of stalk pullback. Prove the stronger intertwining identity for an arbitrary natural transformation between two functors equipped with compatible free and unit comparisons: normalized components commute with every map between standard free sheaves. Naturality on each free inclusion makes each normalized component a common scalar on the summands. Use free_hom_ext and the finite identity sum of projection-inclusion composites to reduce intertwining to a unit-sheaf identity. On every open, linearity says an endomorphism of the unit sends z to z times its value at 1, so the two composites agree by commutativity of the structure ring. This direct calculation needs no freeMatrix injectivity or top-open unit extensionality lemma. Specialize the intertwining identity to D.hom, postcompose with D.inv, and cancel the free isomorphisms. Thus D.hom ; t ; D.inv = t, and cancellation of E_prime gives the equation for exactly E_U. The generalized helper is fully proved, also for noninvertible natural transformations and zero ranks; no holes are introduced.

proof_origin.place: Finite matrix coefficient extension; singleton specialization at the top open, restriction transport, and generalized natural-transformation intertwining proved by a direct sectionwise scalar calculation; S4 repair of duplicate private helpers

lean.statement:
theorem exists_local_free_stalk_map_of_nonempty
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (r s : ℕ) (y : Y)
    (hr : Nonempty (Fin r)) (hs : Nonempty (Fin s))
    (t : (Modules.pullback (Y.fromSpecStalk y)).obj
        (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin r))) ⟶
      (Modules.pullback (Y.fromSpecStalk y)).obj
        (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin s)))) :
    ∃ (U : Y.Opens), ∃ (hyU : y ∈ U), ∃ (g :
      (restrictFunctor U.ι).obj
        (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin r))) ⟶
      (restrictFunctor U.ι).obj
        (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin s)))),
      let E := Functor.isoWhiskerRight (restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι)
          (Modules.pullback (U.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyU)) ≪≫
        pullbackComp (U.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyU) U.ι ≪≫
        pullbackCongr (U.fromSpecStalkOfMem_ι y hyU)
      (Modules.pullback (U.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyU)).map g =
        E.hom.app _ ≫ t ≫ E.inv.app _
